memory_annotations.evidence_summary: The outbound choice is trip-specific: Marcus rejects the Friday morning flight because it would cost useful Boston time and a school day, selecting Thursday evening instead. No broader timing rule is established or revised.

messages.content: Let's settle the Boston dates before we look at hotels. The celebration is Saturday February 21. Compare Thursday evening versus Friday morning out of Chicago, and Monday evening versus Tuesday morning back, for all three of us. Don't book anything.

I found one practical nonstop in each window. Thursday February 19, United leaves ORD at 6:10 p.m. and reaches BOS at 9:32 p.m.; the outbound total for three is $582. Friday February 20, American leaves ORD at 8:05 a.m. and arrives at 11:18 a.m.; that outbound is $714. For the return, JetBlue on Monday February 23 leaves BOS at 5:40 p.m. and lands at ORD at 7:34 p.m. for $627 total. Delta on Tuesday February 24 leaves at 7:30 a.m. and lands at 9:17 a.m. for $510 total. All are nonstop economy fares with one carry-on per person.
Run the four combinations. Assume a Boston hotel will be about $289 a night after tax so the extra night is visible.

Thursday-Monday is $1,209 airfare plus four hotel nights, $1,156, for $2,365 combined. Thursday-Tuesday is $1,092 airfare plus five nights, $1,445, for $2,537. Friday-Monday is $1,341 airfare plus three nights, $867, for $2,208. Friday-Tuesday is $1,224 airfare plus four nights, $1,156, for $2,380. Those figures exclude meals and local transportation.
The three-night version is too compressed. We said this would be four nights, so drop Friday-Monday.

That leaves Thursday-Monday at $2,365, Friday-Tuesday at $2,380, and the five-night Thursday-Tuesday option at $2,537. The two four-night patterns are only $15 apart once the hotel estimate is included.
How much usable time do we actually gain or lose? Thursday night after landing doesn't count for much.

Thursday-Monday gets you to the hotel around 10:20-10:40 Thursday night, then gives you all of Friday through about 3:30 p.m. Monday before leaving for Logan. Friday-Tuesday reaches the hotel area around noon Friday and requires leaving for Logan around 5:15 a.m. Tuesday. So Thursday-Monday provides roughly five more useful Boston hours overall, mostly Friday morning and late morning Monday. Thursday-Tuesday adds a full Monday evening but little usable time Tuesday.
School and work impact next. Owen can miss Friday or Tuesday morning, but not both. Daniel and I already have Monday off.

Thursday-Monday avoids any additional school absence and lets both adults work a normal Thursday before heading to ORD, though the late hotel arrival makes Friday slower. Friday-Tuesday means Owen misses Friday plus at least the first half of Tuesday, so it conflicts with the one-day limit as stated. It also costs both adults Friday and Tuesday morning away from work. Thursday-Tuesday keeps Friday available in Boston but makes Owen miss Tuesday morning and adds one work morning for each adult.
Right, I was treating Tuesday morning as just late arrival, but that is still a second school disruption with Friday. So Friday-Tuesday is out.

Agreed. The realistic choices are now Thursday-Monday for four nights at an estimated $2,365, or Thursday-Tuesday for five nights at $2,537. Both preserve Friday in Boston and avoid a Friday school absence; Tuesday adds $172 overall and creates the Tuesday school and work impact.
Is the Monday return late enough that we can have lunch with family and not spend the afternoon watching the clock?

Yes. With a 5:40 p.m. departure, plan to leave central Boston around 3:15 p.m. That supports an unhurried lunch ending around 1:30 or 2:00, followed by collecting bags. I would not schedule a museum or another timed activity after lunch.

Then take Thursday evening out and Monday evening back as the date plan. The morning departure doesn't help enough here to justify losing Friday, and I don't want the fifth hotel night. Still no booking.

Date plan selected, with nothing booked: Thursday February 19 through Monday February 23, four hotel nights. United departs ORD at 6:10 p.m. Thursday and arrives BOS at 9:32 p.m.; JetBlue returns Monday at 5:40 p.m. and arrives ORD at 7:34 p.m. Airfare for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen is $1,209 total. Using $289 per night, lodging is estimated at $1,156, making the current flight-and-hotel estimate $2,365. The Saturday February 21 celebration is fixed, Friday is fully available in Boston, and Monday allows family lunch before leaving central Boston around 3:15 p.m.
